data.name: ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ
data.meaning: The Most Merciful, The Entirely Merciful
data.desc: The One who wills goodness and mercy for all of His creation; His mercy encompasses everything.

data.name: ٱلرَّحِيمُ
data.desc: The One who is especially merciful and kind to His servants, above all to the believers.

data.name: ٱلْمَلِكُ
data.meaning: The King and Owner of Dominion
data.desc: The true King, whose sovereignty is complete and free from any flaw; everything belongs to Him.

data.name: ٱلْقُدُّوسُ
data.desc: The One who is pure and free from every fault, imperfection, offspring and partner.

data.name: ٱلسَّلَامُ
data.meaning: The Source of Peace, The Flawless
data.desc: The One who grants peace, calm and security, and who is Himself free from every defect.

data.name: ٱلْمُؤْمِنُ
data.meaning: The Granter of Security and Faith
data.desc: The One who grants safety and places faith in hearts, and who fulfils His promises.

data.name: ٱلْمُهَيْمِنُ
data.meaning: The Guardian, The Witness, The Overseer
data.desc: The One who watches over and guards His creation; nothing in this world or the Hereafter is outside His oversight and will.

data.name: ٱلْعَزِيزُ
data.meaning: The Almighty, The All-Powerful, The Invincible, The Honourable
data.desc: The Almighty, whom no one can overcome; He needs no one, and no one can command Him.

data.name: ٱلْجَبَّارُ
data.desc: The One who carries out His will over all things through His greatness and limitless power; He mends what is broken and justly punishes the oppressors.

data.name: ٱلْمُتَكَبِّرُ
data.meaning: The Supreme in Glory, The Rightfully Proud
data.desc: The One who is above all His creation; greatness belongs to Him alone, and no creature has the right to claim it.

data.name: ٱلْخَٰلِقُ
data.desc: The One who brings all things into existence, living or lifeless, moving or still.

data.name: ٱلْبَارِئُ
data.desc: The One who brings creation into being without any earlier model, and makes it free from fault and imperfection.

data.name: ٱلْمُصَوِّرُ
data.desc: The One who gives every creature its form and appearance, inside and out.

data.name: ٱلْغَفَّارُ
data.meaning: The Constant Forgiver, The Great Forgiver
data.desc: The One who forgives again and again; He forgives whatever He wills, for whomever He wills.

data.name: ٱلْقَهَّارُ
data.desc: The One who prevails over all things and keeps all creation subject to His will.

data.name: ٱلْوَهَّابُ
data.meaning: The Giver of Gifts, The Bestower
data.desc: The One who gives generously and without measure, without asking anything in return.

data.name: ٱلرَّزَّاقُ
data.desc: The One who provides every creature with the sustenance it needs.

data.name: ٱلْفَتَّاحُ
data.desc: The One who opens the doors of mercy and provision, and judges between His servants with truth; the keys of the unseen are with Him alone.

data.name: ٱلْعَلِيمُ
data.desc: The One who knows everything; nothing is hidden from Him.

data.name: ٱلْقَابِضُ
data.desc: The One who withholds or restricts provision and good, according to His wisdom.

data.name: ٱلْبَاسِطُ
data.desc: The One who extends and increases provision and good, according to His wisdom.

data.name: ٱلْخَافِضُ
data.desc: The One who lowers the oppressors and the arrogant.

data.name: ٱلرَّافِعُ
data.desc: The One who raises whomever He wills in honour, rank and status, in this world and the Hereafter.

data.name: ٱلْمُعِزُّ
data.meaning: The Honourer, The Bestower of Honour
data.desc: The One who grants honour and esteem to whomever He wills.

data.name: ٱلْمُذِلُّ
data.desc: The One who humbles whomever He wills, however powerful they may be.

data.name: ٱلسَّمِيعُ
data.desc: The One who hears every sound, and hears and answers the supplications of His servants.

data.name: ٱلْبَصِيرُ
data.desc: The One who sees all things; nothing that exists escapes His sight, and He needs no eye or instrument to see.

data.name: ٱلْحَكَمُ
data.meaning: The Judge, The Giver of Justice
data.desc: The One who judges between His creation in this world and the Hereafter; His judgement is perfectly just.

data.name: ٱلْعَدْلُ
data.desc: The One who is perfectly just and free from every kind of injustice and oppression.

data.name: ٱللَّطِيفُ
data.meaning: The Most Gentle, The Subtle One
data.desc: The One who knows the finest details of all things, and who is gentle and kind to His creation.

data.name: ٱلْخَبِيرُ
data.desc: The One who is fully aware of the reality of all things; no detail, great or small, is hidden from Him.

data.name: ٱلْحَلِيمُ
data.desc: The One who is most forbearing; He does not hasten to punish the sinners but gives them time to repent.

data.name: ٱلْعَظِيمُ
data.desc: The One whose greatness and majesty are beyond all imagination, and free from any bodily or material imperfection.

data.name: ٱلْغَفُورُ
data.desc: The One who forgives abundantly, again and again.

data.name: ٱلشَّكُورُ
data.desc: The One who appreciates even the smallest good deed and rewards it many times over.

data.name: ٱلْعَلِيُّ
data.desc: The Most High, exalted above all of His creation.

data.name: ٱلْكَبِيرُ
data.desc: The Greatest, whose greatness is known fully to no one but Him.

data.name: ٱلْحَفِيظُ
data.meaning: The Preserver, The All-Heedful and All-Protecting
data.desc: The One who protects and preserves all things, and keeps a record of every deed.

data.name: ٱلْمُقِيتُ
data.desc: The One who provides every creature with its nourishment, and who has power and watch over all things.

data.name: ٱلْحَسِيبُ
data.desc: The One who takes account of every deed of His creation without forgetting or error, and who is sufficient for His servants.

data.name: ٱلْجَلِيلُ
data.desc: The One who possesses majesty and glory, and is far above any resemblance to His creation.

data.name: ٱلْكَرِيمُ
data.meaning: The Most Generous, The Most Noble
data.desc: The Most Generous and Noble, who has filled His creation with His generosity.

data.name: ٱلرَّقِيبُ
data.desc: The One who watches over all His creation and their deeds at every moment.

data.name: ٱلْمُجِيبُ
data.desc: The One who hears and answers the supplications of His servants.

data.name: ٱلْوَاسِعُ
data.desc: The All-Encompassing, whose knowledge, mercy and generosity extend to everything.

data.name: ٱلْحَكِيمُ
data.desc: The One whose wisdom is perfect; everything He does and decrees is based on wisdom.

data.name: ٱلْوَدُودُ
data.desc: The One who loves His servants and draws near to them with mercy, even when they turn away from Him.

data.name: ٱلْمَجِيدُ
data.desc: The One who is most glorious and noble, who has always been praised and always will be.

data.name: ٱلْبَاعِثُ
data.meaning: The Infuser of New Life, The Resurrector
data.desc: The One who raises the dead to life again, and gives life to whatever He wills.

data.name: ٱلشَّهِيدُ
data.desc: The One who witnesses all things; He is the perfect witness to everything that happens in His kingdom.

data.name: ٱلْحَقُّ
data.desc: The One who is the Truth Himself; His existence is true and every word of His is true.

data.name: ٱلْوَكِيلُ
data.meaning: The Trustee, The Disposer of Affairs
data.desc: The One who manages all affairs, guarantees the provision of His creation, and in whom all can trust.

data.name: ٱلْقَوِيُّ
data.desc: The One whose strength is limitless.

data.name: ٱلْمَتِينُ
data.desc: The One whose strength is firm and never weakens, tires or diminishes.

data.name: ٱلْوَلِيُّ
data.desc: The Protector and Helper of the believers, who guides them and takes care of them.

data.name: ٱلْحَمِيدُ
data.desc: The One who deserves all praise, and is most worthy of glorification and thanks.

data.name: ٱلْمُحْصِي
data.desc: The One who counts every creature, every deed and every particle; nothing is outside His reckoning.

data.name: ٱلْمُبْدِئُ
data.desc: The One who creates for the first time, without any earlier model.

data.name: ٱلْمُعِيدُ
data.desc: The One who brings creation back to life after death.

data.name: ٱلْمُحْيِي
data.desc: The One who gives life, and who will bring the bodies back to life on the Day of Resurrection.

data.name: ٱلْمُمِيتُ
data.meaning: The Taker of Life, The Causer of Death
data.desc: The One who causes death; by death He ends the power of the powerful of this world.

data.name: ٱلْحَيُّ
data.desc: The Ever-Living, whose life has no beginning and no end, and is not like the life of His creation.

data.name: ٱلْقَيُّومُ
data.desc: The One who exists by Himself and sustains all things; He is subject neither to perishing nor to change.

data.name: ٱلْوَاجِدُ
data.desc: The One who finds whatever He wills; He needs nothing and lacks nothing.

data.name: ٱلْمَاجِدُ
data.desc: The Noble and Glorious, who grants countless blessings without asking anything in return.

data.name: ٱلْوَاحِدُ
data.desc: The One who is unique, with no partner or equal in His essence, His attributes or His actions.

data.name: ٱلْأَحَدُ
data.desc: The One who is alone and incomparable, unique in His oneness.

data.name: ٱلصَّمَدُ
data.meaning: The Eternal Refuge, The One Upon Whom All Depend
data.desc: The One who needs no one, while everything depends on Him; He neither begets nor was begotten.

data.name: ٱلْقَادِرُ
data.desc: The One whose power is complete; no weakness touches Him and nothing can render Him unable.

data.name: ٱلْمُقْتَدِرُ
data.desc: The One who has full control over all things, whose power has no limit.

data.name: ٱلْمُقَدِّمُ
data.desc: The One who brings forward whomever He wills, according to His wisdom, and gives everything its place and time.

data.name: ٱلْمُؤَخِّرُ
data.desc: The One who holds back and delays whomever and whatever He wills, according to His wisdom.

data.name: ٱلْأَوَّلُ
data.desc: The First, who has always existed without a beginning; nothing existed before Him.

data.name: ٱلْآخِرُ
data.desc: The Last, who will remain forever when everything else has perished.

data.name: ٱلظَّاهِرُ
data.desc: The One whose existence is manifest in everything through His signs and proofs, and who is above all things.

data.name: ٱلْبَاطِنُ
data.meaning: The Hidden One, Knower of the Hidden
data.desc: The One whose essence the mind cannot grasp, and who knows everything that is hidden.

data.name: ٱلْوَالِي
data.desc: The One who owns, manages and governs all things, and runs every affair with wisdom.

data.name: ٱلْمُتَعَالِي
data.desc: The One who is exalted far above all the attributes of His creation, and whose authority is boundless.

data.name: ٱلْبَرُّ
data.desc: The Source of all goodness and kindness, who showers His blessings on all of His creation.

data.name: ٱلتَّوَّابُ
data.meaning: The Accepter of Repentance, The Ever-Relenting
data.desc: The One who accepts the repentance of His servant whenever he repents, and forgives him.

data.name: ٱلْمُنْتَقِمُ
data.desc: The One who justly brings retribution upon the disobedient and the oppressors.

data.name: ٱلْعَفُوُّ
data.desc: The One who erases sins and pardons.

data.name: ٱلرَّءُوفُ
data.desc: The One who is most kind and compassionate, and grants countless blessings without asking anything in return.

data.name: مَالِكُ ٱلْمُلْكِ
data.meaning: Master of the Dominion, Owner of the Kingdom
data.desc: The Owner of all sovereignty, who gives kingship to whomever He wills and takes it from whomever He wills.

data.name: ذُو ٱلْجَلَالِ وَٱلْإِكْرَامِ
data.desc: The Possessor of majesty and glory, of honour and generosity, who bestows abundant blessings on His servants.

data.name: ٱلْمُقْسِطُ
data.desc: The One who judges with perfect fairness, and is free from all injustice and wrongdoing.

data.name: ٱلْجَامِعُ
data.desc: The One who will gather all of creation on the Day of Resurrection, a Day about which there is no doubt.

data.name: ٱلْغَنِيُّ
data.meaning: The Self-Sufficient, The Free of All Need
data.desc: The One who needs nothing from His creation, while all of His creation needs Him.

data.name: ٱلْمُغْنِي
data.desc: The One who fulfils the needs of His creation and makes them self-sufficient.

data.name: ٱلْمَانِعُ
data.desc: The One who withholds whatever He wills, according to His wisdom, and protects His servants from harm.

data.name: ٱلضَّارُّ
data.desc: The One who alone has the power to bring harm, by His decree; no harm can reach anyone except by His command.

data.name: ٱلنَّافِعُ
data.desc: The One who brings benefit, by His decree; every good comes from Him.

data.name: ٱلنُّورُ
data.desc: The Light of the heavens and the earth, who guides the believers to the light of faith.

data.name: ٱلْهَادِي
data.desc: The One who guides; He shows the straight path to whomever He wills.

data.name: ٱلْبَدِيعُ
data.desc: The One who brings creation and the universe into being in a wondrous way, without any matter or earlier model.

data.name: ٱلْبَاقِي
data.desc: The Everlasting, who is subject neither to perishing nor to change.

data.name: ٱلْوَارِثُ
data.desc: The One who remains after everything else has perished, and is the true Inheritor of all things.

data.name: ٱلرَّشِيدُ
data.meaning: The Guide to the Right Path
data.desc: The One who guides His creation to what is right and good for them; everything He does is right and wise.

data.name: ٱلصَّبُورُ
data.desc: The One who is most patient; He does not hasten to punish the disobedient, but gives them respite until an appointed time.
